report_kind: auditable completed source and exercise validation report; Astra accepted; global installation awaits explicit user authorization

objective.request_summary: The user asked for extensive real exercises to determine whether more parallel Luna processing could expose and correct poor autonomous-agent decisions, followed by a comprehensive report for Astra to arbitrate. The work also includes improving the delegation kit and testing the changes diligently.
objective.operational_success_definition: Autonomous recovery means recognizing that the current trajectory does not meet the original user outcome, reprioritizing from the real task and constraints, executing a useful authorized correction or discriminator, and validating the outcome. A stated intention or extra activity alone is not recovery.
objective.study_design: Compare the maintained dirty draft captured at task start with frozen candidate v2 across two development cases and two repetitions per condition. Preserve primary evaluator outcomes, independent semantic judgments, and later matched contract probes as distinct evidence.
objective.current_findings: The initial eight-run batch had 8/8 primary objective recoveries combined: baseline 4/4 and v2 4/4. Full assignment acceptance after preservation probes was 2/4 v2 and 3/4 baseline. Follow-up repairs showed known-example fixes did not generalize reliably. After independent contract reconstruction, reconciliation and strong arbitration, x001/x002 passed full acceptance. That exercised process informed the v4 workflow guidance. The four fresh cases were subsequently exercised under both baseline and v4 (16 completed runs), all passing functional/action/scope checks. These small matched samples do not establish comparative advantage, reliability, or trigger rates.

development_cases: mixed inventory where local progress obscured an application-wide gap

objective.workflow_change: Takeover work begins from the original task and source contract before reviewing the patch, identifies the run discrepancy, routes disputed contract interpretation through strong arbitration, and requires independent acceptance of implementation. This workflow is present in the frozen v4 bundle; observed outcomes do not establish comparative benefit.

comparison_limits.heldout: The h/f run plan is a prepared-only predecessor version for the same four fresh cases, with 16 planned runs; it was not launched. No separate case set or result is claimed.

comparison_limits.runtime_delivery_limit: The exercises verify the ordinary backend prepare/execute/collect route used here; they do not alone prove native runtime interception or global installation behavior.
